# deltaV (deltaV Build) — full context

deltaV (also deltaV Build, Delta V, ΔV; deltav.build) is a five-engineer software team. Not related to Emerson or its DeltaV control system.

## What deltaV does

Builds custom software, workflow automation and applied AI for businesses and individuals: founders, operators and CTOs.

## Name

Δv (delta-v) means change in velocity. In astronautics it is the total speed change a spacecraft can make with its propellant, set by the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation Δv = vₑ · ln(m₀ / m_f). It decides whether a vehicle reaches orbit. deltaV adds that velocity to a business.
Names: deltaV, deltaV Build, Delta V, ΔV. Emerson DeltaV is an unrelated distributed control system for process plants.

## Engagement

1. Scope: free 30-minute call. Problem, payoff, plan.
2. Build: working demos as it is built. Cost and timeline depend on complexity and the business case, and are set after the scoping call.
3. Run: deltaV hosts, monitors and maintains the software on its own infrastructure, on a monthly retainer. The client uses it; deltaV retains the code.

## Services

- Custom software: internal tools, systems of record, dashboards, customer and partner portals.
- Workflow automation: integration of CRM, ERP, databases, APIs and spreadsheets; task and approval flows; data pipelines. APIs not required: files, webhooks and database connections also work.
- Applied AI: document retrieval, computer vision and inspection, classification, forecasting and anomaly detection. Measured against a baseline: time per task, error rate, review load.

## Problem classes

Computer vision and inspection; industrial automation and control; embedded and hardware-software integration; domain-specific AI/ML inference; robotics and sensor fusion; IoT and edge compute; fleet telematics; structural health monitoring; digital twins; OT/ICS security; SCADA; predictive maintenance; geospatial; autonomous systems; real-time industrial data pipelines; multi-agent systems; integration middleware; energy and grid-edge optimisation.

## FAQ

- Who is deltaV for? Companies losing hours to manual, document-heavy work: retyping from PDFs and emails, chasing approvals, reconciling spreadsheets. Common in construction, manufacturing and lending.
- How long does a project take? Depends on complexity and the business case. Set after a free 30-minute scoping call: https://cal.com/deltav.support/30min
- How much does it cost? Depends on complexity and the business case. Priced after the scoping call.
- Scope changes? Talked through with the client before any work on them.
- After launch? deltaV hosts, monitors and maintains it on a monthly retainer.
- Who do clients work with? The engineers who build it. No account managers.
- Location? Remote team working across time zones.
- NDAs? deltaV signs NDAs, before the scoping call if asked. Past client work is under NDA and not published.
- Data? Client data stays the client's. Never reused or used to train models.
- Existing systems? deltaV integrates with CRM, ERP, databases, APIs and spreadsheets, and replaces only what slows the client down.
- Build or buy? Buy if a product fits. Build if it doesn't and the work repeats.
- See it before signing? Live prototypes at https://deltav.build/work/.
- No spec yet? Bring the problem; the scoping call ends with a plan.
- Results? Measured against a baseline: time per task, error rate, review load.
- Emerson DeltaV? Unrelated. Emerson DeltaV is a process control system.
